method: adversarial grounding audit over 5 random shards, comparing each emitted step against the source book_solution
detail:
Shard: /Users/harshahirrao/Speed gym/data/factory/converted/packet_000.jsonl (4 templates) vs input /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-harshahirrao-Speed-gym/9e5da183-7e68-48e6-be30-660db64bf5ce/scratchpad/templatize/packet_000.json (5 items). Item 5 (sinha_s040x1_q16_20#17) was dropped, not converted — defensible, its book_solution "350 - 275 = 75" is only readable off a bar chart the input never provides, so nothing could be grounded. Flag it as a silent drop rather than a defect.

GROUNDING (2 of 4 carry added reasoning; both additions are small, neither changes an answer):

1) WORST: conv_gre5lb_logicbasedreadingcomprehension_12, step 6 (choice E). Book text stops at "Although waterfront properties are therefore cheaper to acquire, this does not necessarily mean that a developer can make a profit after buying such properties." The template appends "...and it may even hint that waterfront homes fetch less." That is a fresh inferential move (cheaper interior-vs-waterfront pricing implies lower resale) the book never makes, and it is the one addition in this shard that is unmistakably new reasoning rather than unpacking. Steps 1-5 of this template are otherwise a faithful, near-clause-level mapping of the book's conclusion/evidence framing and its A-D eliminations.

2) BORDERLINE: conv_as_quant_p175_taste_of_the_examsblock_i_29, steps 1 and 3. The book simply asserts "If b-d=d, it must be the case that b is 10 and d is 5" with no justification. The template supplies one: operation "b - d = d \Rightarrow b = 2d" plus description "look for the only pair inside the given number set where one value is double the other." The b=2d rearrangement is a restatement of the stem's own equation, but the search method ("scan the set for a double", echoed again in key_reminders) is derivation the book never gave. Step 3 also emits "so c = 2"; the book assigns only a=4 and e=6 and never states c. Both are forced and correct, but under a strict grounding rule they are template-invented intermediate content — counted.

NOT counted, noted: conv_tyra_prob_p0229_ex5_Ex_5 step 1 renders "52 Sundays are guaranteed" and step 2 adds "equally likely" — these unpack the book's own "52 weeks + 2 days ... one of 7 consecutive-day pairs" rather than adding a new move. Its step 3 reproduces {Sun-Mon, Sat-Sun} -> 2/7 verbatim from the book.

CLEANEST: conv_tyra_hcflcm_p0090_c_Ex__9 — all 5 steps map 1:1 onto the book's clauses (LCM 60 -> 60k; constant deficit 1 -> 60k-1; 60k-1 = 7(8k)+(4k-1); least k with 7 | (4k-1) is 2; 60x2-1 = 119). Only addition is the arithmetic check "4(2)-1 = 7", which verifies the book's own criterion. Fully grounded.

DESCRIPTION/OPERATION ALIGNMENT: 0 misaligned across all 19 steps. Every description narrates its own operation, including the six per-choice steps in the GRE template, which do not drift into neighbouring choices.

ANSWER FIDELITY: 0 altered. "(b)", "(B)", "(i) 2/7 (ii) 1/7", "119" are byte-identical to the corresponding answer_key values. Note the probability template silently corrects a stem typo ("if the year selected in not a leap year" -> "is not"); harmless, but it is an edit to source text.

SCHEMA: clean. No "$" anywhere in the shard; zero non-ASCII characters in any of the 4 records (no metric-less Unicode). expected_time 70/75/45/70, all inside 15-300. step_num sequences contiguous from 1. Scaffolds plausible: equation_chain for the letter-code system and the LCM chain, textual_scaffold for the GRE argument; textual_scaffold for the leap-year counting problem is the weakest fit (an enumeration of the 7 day-pairs would suit a table better) but is not wrong.

STRICT FLAGS — real invented text, all OUTSIDE the audited step fields (worst offenders, in order):
1. conv_greog_8practicetest1_section4verbalreasonin_2 — the worst. Its problem_statement opens with "Select the two answer choices that, when used to complete the sentence, fit the meaning of the sentence as a whole and produce completed sentences that are alike in meaning." The source `directions` field is TRUNCATED mid-clause at "...fit the meaning of". Everything after that is reconstructed ETS boilerplate present nowhere in the input packet. Correct boilerplate, but fabricated text in a learner-facing field.
2. conv_gre5lb_textcompletions_120 — common_mistakes[2] "Choosing quarrelsome factions for blank (iii): the sentence needs the group you would expect to agree, not one already defined by disagreement." The book solution never mentions a single wrong option; this is entirely converter-authored distractor analysis.

COVERAGE (2 of 5 items dropped — correctly): greets_mixedpracticepracticeset3#22 has an empty `stimulus` and its solution quotes a passage absent from the packet, so it is unreconstructible; greog_..._section5quantitativere#8's book_solution is OCR-destroyed ("Since , you need to compare with .") with every quantity missing. Dropping both is the grounding-correct call. Best judgment call in the shard: greqnt_..._352#7's source stem is polluted with pages of unrelated body text on roots and perfect squares, and its `options` list ((A) 11 ... (E) 66) belongs to a DIFFERENT question whose answer is 11, not 7. The converter isolated the real question and discarded the mismatched options rather than emitting a stem whose choices contradict its own answer key.

Shard: /Users/harshahirrao/Speed gym/data/factory/converted/packet_042.jsonl (5 templates) vs /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-harshahirrao-Speed-gym/9e5da183-7e68-48e6-be30-660db64bf5ce/scratchpad/templatize/packet_042.json.

GROUNDING (0 violations). Every solution step traces to a clause in the source book_solution, step-for-step and in the book's own order:
- conv_as_quant_p364_level_of_difficulty_i_28: 4 steps = book's 4 sentences (3150 / 1500 / 1650 / 1650-30=55). The only addition is step 4's parenthetical "(the original 15 plus the 15 additional men)", which restates the stem, not new derivation.

- conv_tyra_pl_p0338_ex5_Ex_5: both book methods preserved; step 6 reproduces the cross formula exactly as printed, (9x20 - 16x11)/(16x11) x 100. Only step 4 (180-176=4) is an implicit-made-explicit subtraction from the book's "profit 4 on 176" — legitimate prose-to-step.
- conv_tyra_numsys_p0184_misc_ex24_Ex_24: all five steps are the book's own line, including x(81-49)/(7x9); step 3's result 32x/63 is a literal evaluation of the book's own expression, not new reasoning. Correctly ends on 7/12 rather than x=3/4.
- conv_sinha_s032x1_q08_12_11: 3 steps = the book's one-sentence argument (same profit % -> income rises 20% -> 120/100 = 1.2). The chart values embedded in problem_statement (B: 30/60/80/80/70/100) map correctly onto x_labels 2003-2008 from the input stimulus.

MISALIGNMENT (0). Every description narrates its own operation; no step describes a neighbour's work.

ANSWER FIDELITY (0 alterations). All five answers byte-identical to answer_key: "(c)", "Inundated", "gain 2 3/11 %", "7/12", "(b)".

SCHEMA (clean). No $ delimiters anywhere; expected_time 45/45/50/75/80 all inside 15-300; scaffolds plausible (textual_scaffold for the GRE verbal item, equation_chain for the four computational ones); difficulty_inferred:true present on exactly the four items whose source difficulty was null and absent on the one with a printed difficulty (Arun Sharma, 2). Non-ASCII found is only typographic punctuation carried from the source stems (curly quotes, em dashes) — no metric-less math symbols.

WORST OFFENDERS — three residual concerns, none of which trips the four graded criteria, listed most-serious first:
1. conv_gre5lb_textcompletions_19 (real defect, outside the graded axes): the problem_statement drops the five answer choices entirely, yet step 3's operation is "Eliminate vanquished, blacklisted, boycotted, berated" and step 4 checks "the survivor". The steps operate on data the presented problem never shows, so the template is not self-contained for a learner. Note conv_sinha_s032x1_q08_12_11 does inline its options — the two are inconsistent. Worth a fix pass.
2. conv_sinha_s032x1_q08_12_11 key_reminders[0] states "Percentage profit = (income - expenditure)/expenditure x 100", a formula the book solution never gives (it only asserts the profit percentages are equal). It is correct and standard, but it is imported knowledge. It sits in key_reminders, not in a step, so I did not count it as ungrounded under criterion 1 — flagging it in case the parent scopes grounding to the whole template rather than to steps. Same caveat, weaker, for its common_mistakes entry, which invents the 1.2 x 1.8 = 2.16 trap rationale (arithmetic checks out and matches distractor (a), but the book never mentions it).
3. Two borderline descriptive glosses I judged as allowed prose-to-step conversion, not fabricated derivation: conv_tyra_pl_p0338_ex5_Ex_5 step 1 justifies the choice of 99 ("so both lot sizes divide it exactly and no fractions appear") where the book only says "Take 99 oranges"; conv_gre5lb_textcompletions_19 step 4 describes "substituting its meaning back into the sentence" where the book only says "Only inundated makes sense". Both restate self-evident properties rather than adding a method with consequences.

Provenance observation (input-side, not a conversion fault): the packet_042 stimulus title for the Sinha chart says the B-2005/2006 = 80 values were "confirmed by answer key (Q11=1.2x)", i.e. reverse-engineered from the answer being audited. The converted template presents those values as given chart data. The conversion is faithful to its input; the circularity is upstream.

Audited /Users/harshahirrao/Speed gym/data/factory/converted/packet_063.jsonl (3 templates) against /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-harshahirrao-Speed-gym/9e5da183-7e68-48e6-be30-660db64bf5ce/scratchpad/templatize/packet_063.json (5 items).

WORST OFFENDER — conv_greog_6quantitativep_set2discretequestionsm_3 (ETS OG QC, circle/quadrilateral). Two defects, both in the same template:

(1) UNGROUNDED (step 5). The source book_solution has a PDF-extraction hole: "The area of each of the right triangles is , or 12.5" — the formula itself is missing from the text. The template fills that hole with reconstructed derivation: operation "Each right triangle has legs equal to the radius: \frac{1}{2}(5)(5)", description "whose two legs are each half of the diameter 10, that is, the radius 5." Neither the triangle-area formula, the legs-are-radius rule, nor the intermediate value 5 appears anywhere in the book solution; only the output 12.5 does. It is mathematically correct and almost certainly what the printed book said, but it is derivation the source as supplied does not contain. Step 4 also adds "four congruent right triangles" — the book says only "four right triangles"; congruence is the load-bearing claim that licenses 4x12.5, and it is inserted.

(2) MISALIGNMENT (step 1). Operation: "List what is actually given: circle diameter = 10, and A, B, C, D lie on the circle in the order shown", result "Only the diameter and the cyclic order of the four points are fixed". Its own description says "Separate the given information from what the picture merely looks like" — yet the operation does the opposite, folding the picture-derived fact into the "actually given" bucket. The book is explicit about the split: "You are given that the circle has a diameter of 10, and from the figure you can assume that points A, B, C, and D lie on the circle in the order shown." The same conflation is pushed up into problem_statement, which restates the order-on-circle fact as a stated given (original stem says only "the diameter of the circle is 10"), so the template silently converts an assumption into a premise.

CLEAN-ISH, with borderlines noted:
- conv_gre5lb_textcompletions_29: all three steps track the book ("all clues are about being scared" -> tremulous; "even more frightening" -> milder fear -> chary of, with the book's own gloss "suspicious or slightly scared of" preserved). Borderline: step 2 adds "coltish and cumbersome describe something other than being scared," an elimination the book never states — judged implicit in the book's "matches best." Separately, common_mistakes (outside the steps, so not counted) asserts "repulsed by ... too extreme to be outranked by 'even more frightening'", which is invented rationale.
- conv_greog_9practicetest2_section4verbalreasonin_15: steps mirror the book closely, including the decisive "gracious fits but has no near-synonym among the choices" elimination. Borderline: step 1's result "A show of delight at her own defeat would be insincere" is a bridging generalization the book leaves implicit, and step 2's "they are alike in meaning" is a Sentence-Equivalence format requirement rather than a stated book claim.

ANSWERS: 3/3 emitted verbatim equal to answer_key ("Tremulous, chary of"; "Choice D: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given."; "Choice B: ecstatic AND Choice E: euphoric"). Zero alterations.

SCHEMA SANITY: clean across all 3. No $ delimiters anywhere; zero non-ASCII characters in the whole shard (so no metric-less Unicode); expected_time 45/110/60 all inside 15-300; scaffolds plausible (textual_scaffold for the two verbal items, shape_canvas for the circle geometry); every step object has exactly step_num/operation/result/description. Note conv_greog_9practicetest2..._15 omits difficulty_inferred, which is correct — its difficulty 3 came from the source's ETS p-plus statistic, unlike the other two which are marked inferred.

DROP BEHAVIOR (favorable): 2 of 5 inputs were correctly not emitted — greets_mixedpracticepracticeset2#12 (RC "primary purpose" whose passage is absent from the stimulus) and greqnt_formulasandfunctionscheckyourskillscheck_207#2 (book_solution truncated mid-sentence at "Then, substitute that result for 3 D 1:", so the final arithmetic to 20 was unavailable). The converter refused to invent those two, which makes the gap-filling in template 2 an inconsistency in its own discipline rather than a uniform policy.

VERDICT: mixed. 1 of 3 templates (33%) contains reconstructed derivation absent from its source plus a step whose operation contradicts its own description; the other 2 are grounded with only minor implicit-bridge elaborations. Recommend regenerating conv_greog_6quantitativep_set2discretequestionsm_3 — or, given the source's extraction hole, dropping it the way the other two unusable items were dropped.

Shard: /Users/harshahirrao/Speed gym/data/factory/converted/packet_084.jsonl (3 templates) vs input /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-harshahirrao-Speed-gym/9e5da183-7e68-48e6-be30-660db64bf5ce/scratchpad/templatize/packet_084.json (5 items).

GROUNDING (0 ungrounded): every solution step traces to text present in its book_solution.
- conv_greog_8practicetest1_section5quantitativere_7 is the cleanest: steps 1-6 map one-to-one onto the book's sentences (|-2|=|2|=2; the eight qualifying integers and "these are the only such integers"; X = {-5,-4,-3,-2,2,3,4,5}; greatest 5 -> |5|; least -5 -> |-5|; therefore equal). No invented method or intermediate value.
- conv_gre5lb_textcompletions_17: target meaning ("unanimously criticized"/"100% disliked"), roundly = "emphatically / so thoroughly as to leave no doubt", panned = "reviewed negatively, almost always of plays and movies" are all verbatim from the book. Closest call in the shard, and the only thing I would call soft: step 2/3 descriptions assign each blank a specific half of the target meaning ("the first blank, which must carry the totality of the criticism"). The book never states that split explicitly - it just defines both words in sequence. I judged it grounded because the split follows immediately from the two definitions the book itself places side by side, but it is the one place a reviewer could argue derivation was added.
- conv_greqnt_ratesproblemsetproblemset_969_6: every chart row (1.6e8 / 0.8e8 / 0.4e8 / 0.2e8 / 0.1e8), the "doubling is every two years, not every year" caution, and "convert to eliminate the decimal" are all in the book. Step 6's stated result (1 x 10^7) is not written in the book but is the book-instructed conversion landing on the answer key, so not fabricated derivation.

MISALIGNMENT (0): every description narrates its own operation. No copy-paste of a neighboring step, no step describing the whole problem. Step 5 of the absolute-value template cross-references step 1 ("by step 1 the minus sign drops away") but still describes its own operation.

ANSWER ALTERATION (1) - the worst offender: conv_greqnt_ratesproblemsetproblemset_969_6 emits "(C) 1 \times 10^7" where answer_key is "(C) 1 × 107". Not verbatim. It is a defensible repair of an OCR-lost exponent (the source stem and options are equally corrupted: "1.6 × 108", "4 × 107"), and the same silent reconstruction runs through the problem_statement and every step. But it is exactly the class of edit an audit must catch: a downstream exact-match grader against answer_key will fail this row, and the converter reconstructed exponents nowhere asserted in the source. The other two answers are byte-identical to their keys.

SCHEMA: clean. Zero "$" characters anywhere in the shard; zero non-ASCII bytes (the Unicode × / ≤ / − of the source were converted to \times, \le, "-"); expected_time 45 / 115 / 75 all inside 15-300; step_num sequences contiguous from 1; scaffold types textual_scaffold, number_line, equation_chain are all attested elsewhere in the corpus and plausible for their steps. difficulty=5 on the ETS item carries no difficulty_inferred flag, which is correct - that item has a real source difficulty ("ets_p_plus=26"); the other two are flagged inferred as they should be.

DROP DISCIPLINE (positive): 2 of 5 inputs were correctly withheld rather than confabulated - vms_exercises_38_44#38 (book_solution is the stub "Appendix F cross-reference: (Section 10)") and greets_readingcomprehensionpracticeset3ha#5, whose book_solution is about snail-shell chirality while its stem and answer_key are about a cycling boom, i.e. corrupted source pairing. Emitting either would have required inventing the entire derivation.

Residual, non-blocking: common_mistakes on all three templates are converter-authored distractor analysis with no book support (e.g. "Reading 2 \le |n| \le 5 as 2 \le n \le 5", "Choosing lauded or venerated"). Each is sound and none contaminates the solution steps, but if grounding is meant to bind the whole record and not just the steps, these fields are ungrounded by construction across the shard.
